purpose: Provide a credential-free Foundation ingestion boundary for verified management-plane deployment receipts, automatically reconciling canonical deployment truth while forcing every new runtime to earn fresh health, audit and readiness evidence.
effects: for foundation.gateway return immediate readiness evaluation

states.drift: Receipt exists but canonical deployment truth is not aligned.
states.awaiting-proof: Deployment is reconciled but current runtime has not yet earned its own health/readiness proof.
states.reconciled: Deployment truth is aligned and current runtime proof is present.

observerBoundary.rule: An external trusted observer fetches provider deployment metadata, verifies exact source/artifact evidence, and submits only the non-secret receipt through service_role.
